phase: BNR BLS Missing-Round Official-Publication Text Bridge
purpose: Retain only official BNR publication-text evidence for the four calendar quarters absent from the canonical workbook-derived BLS panel. This bridge distinguishes direct reported net percentages and exact status-quo implications from incomplete response-share narratives. It is corroboration/source-recovery evidence only and may not silently substitute publication-rounded values for workbook-cell precision.

admissible_evidence_classes.DIRECT_REPORTED_NET_PERCENTAGE: The publication text explicitly reports the target net percentage.
admissible_evidence_classes.DIRECT_STATUS_QUO_IMPLIES_ZERO: The publication states that all responding institutions reported no change, which implies an exact zero balance under the BNR net-percentage definition.
admissible_evidence_classes.INCOMPLETE_NARRATIVE_ONLY: The publication text describes direction or response shares but does not identify a unique publication-precision net percentage.
admissible_evidence_classes.ROUNDED_SHARE_BALANCE_DIAGNOSTIC_ONLY: A balance can be computed from publication-rounded response shares, but it is diagnostic only and cannot replace the original workbook value.

next_gate: Recover and retain exact official workbook bytes/cell values for the missing canonical quarters. Publication-text evidence may be used to validate identity, sign and approximate/reporting-precision values, not to manufacture workbook precision.
